importMappings.create.description: Imports choose it by name. Findings it imports record the source as mapped:<name>.
importMappings.create.name: Name
importMappings.create.nameHelp: Lower-case letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore; starts with a letter or digit; at most 64.
importMappings.create.title: Save the mapping
importMappings.delete.description: Imports that name it stop working. Findings it imported stay as they are.
importMappings.delete.title: Delete this mapping?
importMappings.details.description: Renaming changes the name imports use (format mapping:<name>) and the source recorded on findings imported from now on.
importMappings.details.title: Name and description
importMappings.editor.jsonInvalid: Not a mapping document yet: it needs valid JSON with source and records. The table keeps the last valid version.
importMappings.editor.newDescription: Map the columns of a CSV, JSON, JSON Lines or XML export to findings and assets, checking the result on a sample.
importMappings.editor.noPermission: Creating a mapping needs the permission to manage integrations.
importMappings.identity.description: This version identifies findings differently. Findings imported with earlier versions will not match the ones this version imports: the same issue comes in as a new finding. Earlier findings stay as they are; an operator can re-key them with the refingerprint tool.
importMappings.identity.sameMembers: The members are the same, but the values they are read from changed.
importMappings.identity.title: Change how findings are identified?
importMappings.list.description: Turn any CSV, JSON, JSON Lines or XML export into findings and assets. Choose a mapping as the format when you import results.
importMappings.list.emptyDescription: Start from a template for a generic CSV, findings JSON or test-results XML, and check it on a sample before saving.
importMappings.list.title: Import mappings
importMappings.preview.collisionHelp: They would be imported as one finding. Add an identity field that tells them apart, such as the location or the asset.
importMappings.preview.collisionTitle: Different records get the same identity
importMappings.preview.empty: The mapping makes nothing from this sample.
importMappings.preview.invalid: The mapping is not valid yet
importMappings.preview.limited: Too many previews in a short time. The preview updates again after your next change in a moment.
importMappings.preview.noPermission: Previewing a sample needs the permission to manage integrations.
importMappings.preview.noSample: Choose a sample file to see the findings and assets this mapping makes from it.
importMappings.preview.truncated: Only the first part of the sample was read.
importMappings.problem.identityRequired: Tick Identity on at least one field: it tells one finding from another.
importMappings.problem.identityUnset: Rule {rule}: the identity field {target} must be set by every finding rule.
importMappings.problem.label: To fix
importMappings.problem.missingTarget: Rule {rule}: pick a field for every row.
importMappings.sample.chosen: {name}, {size} KiB. Only used for the preview; nothing is stored.
importMappings.sample.eachJsonHelp: Leave empty when the document is the list itself, or one record.
importMappings.sample.eachXmlHelp: Required. An absolute element path such as /testsuites/testsuite/testcase, or //name for that element at any depth.
importMappings.sample.help: Up to 5 MiB. The preview reads it with the mapping; nothing is stored.
importMappings.sample.tooLarge: The sample is larger than 5 MiB
importMappings.save.description: Imports that name the mapping without a version use the new version. Earlier versions stay available.
importMappings.save.title: Save as version {v}
importMappings.start.blankHelp: One finding per CSV row from title and severity columns; build the rest from your sample.
importMappings.start.title: Start from
importMappings.table.when: Applies when: {conditions}. Edit conditions in the JSON document.
importMappings.transform.description: Applied in this order: first item, trim and case, split, value table, join, convert, size limit. The default replaces a missing or empty result.
importMappings.transform.mapHelp: Replace source values, such as words for severities. A value not in the table is treated as missing.
importMappings.transform.noVars: Write variables in the template as {name}, then give each one a source path here.
importMappings.transform.title: Transforms for {target}
